correctness.rationale: For each n>=3, matchings with no spoke form A=Ind(P_{n-1}), while faces with a unique spoke s_i form cones s_i*B_i, B_i=Ind(P_max(i-2,0))*Ind(P_max(n-i-1,0)); cones intersect each other only in A. The path complex recurrence Ind(P_m)~Sigma Ind(P_(m-3)) follows by vertex deletion whose remaining path has an isolated endpoint, and has correct cases S^(a-1), contractible, S^a by m modulo 3. For n=3q, q>=2, q noncontractible B_i are S^(q-2), maps to A~S^(q-1) are null by connectivity; n=3 directly gives three contractible components. For n=3q+2, base is contractible, exactly 2q+2 links S^(q-1) suspend to S^q. For n=3q+1, B_1->A is a homotopy equivalence by contractible endpoint link, making base contractible, and q other S^(q-1) links yield q S^q. The homotopy pushout argument is integral, not just homology. Independently enumerated all matching faces and alternating reduced Euler characteristics n=3..19, matching all predicted sphere multiplicities. Source finite F2 verifier/recorded output n=3..15 was read but not treated as a universal proof.
